name: contextforge-v2
description: Desktop app that lets one developer use many AIs to build games without losing context or breaking dependencies.
//: tree-sitter-typescript@0.23.2 and tree-sitter-gdscript@6.1.0 still declare peer deps on tree-sitter ^0.21.x, so installing alongside tree-sitter 0.25 needs --legacy-peer-deps. See D17.

scripts.postinstall: echo "If npm failed on a peer-dependency conflict: use 'npm install --legacy-peer-deps' (see D17)."
